description:
Configure product relationships for the 'Business Laptop Pro' (SKU: LAPTOP-001). Navigate to Catalog > Products and edit the laptop product. In the 'Related Products, Up-Sells, and Cross-Sells' section, configure the following: 

1. **Related Products**: Wireless Headphones (HEADPHONES-001) and LED Desk Lamp (LAMP-001)
2. **Up-Sell Products**: Smartphone Ultra (PHONE-001)
3. **Cross-Sell Products**: Insulated Water Bottle (BOTTLE-001), Memory Foam Pillow (PILLOW-001), and Yoga Mat Premium (YOGA-001)

Save the product when finished. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
